intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

selected_hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking scenery.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three to four prime snorkeling spots across the atoll, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world. Ideal for couples who love ocean adventures.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage or body treatment inside a stunning glass-walled underwater spa, surrounded by the gentle movement of tropical fish and coral reefs. This ultra-luxurious experience combines wellness with the mesmerizing beauty of the ocean, making it one of the most unique and romantic spa experiences in the world.

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean, where a candlelit table for two awaits. Enjoy a gourmet multi-course dinner featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, lobster, and tropical desserts, all prepared by a private chef. Stargazing under the Milky Way caps off this unforgettable honeymoon experience.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Step beyond the resort and visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Join a hands-on cooking class led by a local family, learning to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa short eats. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local mosque, and connect with the warm Maldivian community.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then arrange a speedboat or public ferry transfer to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll. Check in, freshen up, and take a relaxed stroll along the beach to get your bearings. Enjoy the stunning turquoise lagoon views from your accommodation.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach or jetty near your guesthouse. Explore the immediate surroundings of your guesthouse island on foot and get oriented with local amenities, shops, and nearby cafes.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the airport before or during layover
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport or a local cafe near the ferry terminal before transfer
meals.dinner: Dinner at your guesthouse restaurant or a nearby local eatery — try Maldivian fish curry with rice (mas riha), a staple budget meal under $8-12 USD

day_by_day.notes: Book your speedboat or public ferry transfer in advance. Public ferries are significantly cheaper ($1-3 USD) compared to speedboats ($15-25 USD). Confirm transfer options with your boutique stay ahead of arrival.

day_by_day.morning: After a hearty breakfast, head out for your first snorkeling session at the house reef near your guesthouse. Most budget guesthouses in North Malé Atoll offer free or low-cost snorkel gear rental ($3-5 USD/day). Explore the vibrant coral gardens and spot tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks in the crystal-clear waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion to a nearby snorkel point or sandbank organized by your guesthouse. These group trips typically cost $20-35 USD per person and include multiple snorkel spots. Look out for manta rays and nurse sharks at popular North Malé Atoll sites.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the island and relax on the beach. Visit a local shop to pick up snacks and water. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner with your partner as the stars begin to appear over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — typically includes eggs, toast, fresh tropical fruit, and tea/coffee (often included or $5-8 USD)
meals.lunch: Pack a simple lunch from a local shop or eat at a beachside cafe — tuna sandwiches or short eats (hedhikaa) for $3-6 USD
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — grilled fish with coconut rice and salad for $10-15 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only to protect the coral ecosystem. Bring a reusable water bottle as buying bottled water daily adds up. Most guesthouses can arrange snorkeling trips at competitive group rates.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the house reef before the sun gets too strong — this is the best time to spot marine life when the water is calm and visibility is at its peak. Look for hawksbill sea turtles that are commonly seen in North Malé Atoll reefs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a local public ferry or arrange a budget day trip to a nearby inhabited local island. Explore the local community, visit the island's mosque, wander through colorful narrow streets, and interact with friendly Maldivian locals to get an authentic cultural experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your guesthouse island before sunset. Enjoy a romantic evening walk on the beach, collect shells, and watch the spectacular Indian Ocean sunset paint the sky in shades of orange and pink.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh papaya, banana pancakes, and local tea
meals.lunch: Eat at a local teahouse (sai hotel) on the inhabited island — try garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice and lime for $3-5 USD
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner or nearby restaurant — BBQ fish night if available, usually $12-18 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting inhabited local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic culture. Bikinis are only appropriate on designated tourist beaches.

day_by_day.morning: Book a budget dolphin watching cruise — a magical experience in the Maldives, especially at dawn. Many guesthouses arrange shared sunrise dolphin cruises for $25-40 USD per person. Spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in North Malé Atoll waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: After returning from the cruise, spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach. Set up a romantic picnic on the sand with fruits, snacks, and coconut water purchased from local shops. Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere and each other's company.
day_by_day.evening: Stargaze on the beach after dinner — the Maldives offers some of the most spectacular stargazing in the world due to minimal light pollution. Lay on the beach and identify constellations over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early morning cruise — fruit, granola bar, and water
meals.lunch: Post-cruise lunch at guesthouse or local cafe — tuna wrap or rice and curry for $6-10 USD
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at your guesthouse — request a beachside table if available, grilled snapper with vegetables for $12-16 USD

day_by_day.notes: Book the dolphin cruise at least one day in advance. Shared group tours are much more budget-friendly than private charters. Bring a light jacket for the early morning sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning snorkeling trip to a famous nearby dive/snorkel spot such as Banana Reef or HP Reef (Maaya Thila), both accessible from North Malé Atoll. These UNESCO-recognized reefs are teeming with marine biodiversity including Napoleon wrasse, eagle rays, and colorful reef fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby sandbank (finolhu) — a tiny strip of pure white sand emerging from the turquoise lagoon. Many guesthouses arrange sandbank picnic trips for $15-25 USD per person. Spend the afternoon swimming, snorkeling, and enjoying the surreal isolation of a private sandbank.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise around the atoll. Traditional wooden dhoni boats offer romantic sunset cruises for $15-25 USD per person. Sip on fresh lime juice and enjoy the golden hour on the water.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — egg omelet, toast, fresh juice, and coffee
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the sandbank or quick meal at a local cafe upon return — $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — Maldivian lobster or grilled reef fish if budget allows as a special treat, $15-25 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank experience is quintessentially Maldivian and very romantic — ideal for honeymoon couples. Bring plenty of sunscreen, a hat, and extra water as there is no shade on sandbanks.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and leisure morning — sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and spend time relaxing by the beach or pool at your guesthouse. This is your mid-trip recovery day. Read, journal, or simply enjoy the peaceful island atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the underwater world with a budget snorkeling session at a different section of the house reef. Try snorkeling at high tide for the best coral visibility. Look for octopus, moray eels, and colorful parrotfish in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a special romantic candlelit beach dinner through your guesthouse — many budget guesthouses offer this as an add-on for $30-50 USD for two, including a set menu of grilled seafood, salad, and dessert. A perfect honeymoon evening under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely guesthouse breakfast — fresh fruit platter, yogurt, and local roshi (flatbread) with coconut chutney
meals.lunch: Light lunch at guesthouse or local cafe — tuna salad or short eats for $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Special candlelit beach dinner arranged through guesthouse — $30-50 USD for two as a romantic splurge

day_by_day.notes: The candlelit beach dinner is a worthwhile splurge for honeymoon couples and still very affordable compared to resort prices. Book it in advance with your guesthouse host.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Malé, the capital city of the Maldives. Take a public ferry from your island ($1-2 USD) to Malé. Visit the iconic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) — a 17th-century coral stone mosque, a UNESCO-listed heritage site. Also visit the National Museum for a deeper understanding of Maldivian history.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Malé's vibrant local fish market (the largest in the Maldives) and the bustling local market. Browse for affordable souvenirs like lacquerware, woven mats, and local spices. Walk along the Malé waterfront promenade and observe the busy harbor.
day_by_day.evening: Head back to your guesthouse island via public ferry before dark. Relax and debrief the day's adventures over dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early guesthouse breakfast before ferry departure
meals.lunch: Eat at a local Maldivian restaurant in Malé — a full meal of rice, curry, and fish costs $4-7 USD, some of the best value food in the Maldives
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner upon return — simple fish curry and rice, $8-12 USD

day_by_day.notes: Malé is very compact and easily walkable. The fish market is most lively in the early morning and late afternoon. Keep valuables secure in the busy market area. The National Museum entry fee is approximately $3-5 USD.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling at a new reef spot — ask your guesthouse to recommend a lesser-known snorkel site away from tourist crowds. Exploring off-the-beaten-path reefs often yields the most spectacular marine encounters including whale sharks (seasonal).
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the beach and try some water activities offered by your guesthouse such as kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding (SUP). These are often available for free or at low cost ($5-10 USD/hour) at budget guesthouses. Paddle around the lagoon for a different perspective of the island.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic evening on the beach. Build a sandcastle, collect shells as keepsakes, and watch the bioluminescent plankton light up the shoreline after dark — a magical natural phenomenon common in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — pancakes with honey, fresh mango, and tea
meals.lunch: Beach picnic — pick up fresh coconuts, local short eats, and fruit from a nearby shop for $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Local restaurant — try mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) with roshi for a traditional Maldivian dinner, $8-12 USD

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton (sea sparkle) is best seen on dark, moonless nights between May and November but can occasionally be spotted year-round. Walk along the shoreline after 10 PM and look for the blue glow in the waves.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group snorkeling and island hopping tour — a popular activity in North Malé Atoll that visits multiple snorkel spots, a sandbank, and a local island in one day. These group tours cost $35-55 USD per person and offer excellent value for money.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour — visit a second local inhabited island, explore the community, and enjoy a swim at a designated tourist beach. These tours typically include a simple lunch.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your guesthouse by late afternoon. Spend the evening relaxing on the beach with a cold drink. Share your favorite memories of the trip so far and plan the remaining days together.

meals.breakfast: Early guesthouse breakfast before the tour departure
meals.lunch: Lunch included in the island hopping tour package — typically a simple BBQ fish and rice meal on a sandbank
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner or local restaurant — grilled barracuda or reef fish with coconut rice, $10-15 USD

day_by_day.notes: Island hopping tours are one of the best value activities in the Maldives. Book through your guesthouse to get the best group rate. Bring a dry bag for your valuables, sunscreen, and a towel.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning — enjoy a slow breakfast and spend time reading or journaling on the beach. Take a leisurely swim in the lagoon and practice snorkeling techniques in the shallow waters near the shore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby resort island for a day pass experience — some luxury resorts in North Malé Atoll offer day passes ($50-150 USD per person) that include access to their beach, pool, and sometimes meals. This is an affordable way to experience Maldivian luxury on a budget for a day.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your guesthouse and enjoy a relaxed evening. Treat yourselves to a couple's massage at a local spa or your guesthouse spa if available — budget guesthouse massages typically cost $30-60 USD for a 60-minute session.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort day pass venue (may be included in day pass or available at resort cafe prices — budget $20-30 USD)
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — light meal of soup and salad after an indulgent lunch, $8-12 USD

day_by_day.notes: Research resort day passes in advance as availability is limited. This is a great way to experience the luxury resort atmosphere without paying resort accommodation prices. Compare a few resorts for the best day pass value.

day_by_day.morning: Final dedicated snorkeling morning — revisit your favorite reef spot or try a new one recommended by your guesthouse host. Spend extended time underwater to soak in the incredible marine biodiversity one last time before the trip winds down.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on the beach doing absolutely nothing — read, nap, swim, and enjoy the paradise surroundings. This is your ultimate relaxation afternoon. Collect a small jar of sand as a free honeymoon keepsake.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic sunset walk along the beach. Find a quiet spot to sit together and watch the sun dip below the horizon. Reflect on your honeymoon adventure and the memories created in this beautiful destination.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — egg benedict or local breakfast special
meals.lunch: Beach cafe or guesthouse lunch — fresh grilled fish sandwich and coconut water, $7-10 USD
meals.dinner: Special dinner at the best local restaurant on the island — splurge slightly on a seafood platter for two, $25-40 USD as a pre-departure treat

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing non-essential items this evening to make departure day smoother. Check your ferry or speedboat transfer schedule back to Malé for your departure.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkel or swim at the house reef — say goodbye to the underwater world. After breakfast, take a final walk around your guesthouse island to capture last photos and soak in the atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at local shops on the island or arrange a short trip to a nearby inhabited island market. Look for affordable Maldivian handicrafts, lacquerware boxes, woven coconut leaf items, and local spices as gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your guesthouse — request your favorite meal from the trip. Spend the evening packing, reviewing your experiences, and expressing gratitude to your guesthouse hosts who made your budget honeymoon memorable.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — enjoy your final full island breakfast
meals.lunch: Light lunch — tuna wrap and fresh juice, $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at guesthouse — your favorite meal from the trip, $10-15 USD

day_by_day.notes: Leave a positive review for your guesthouse online — budget guesthouses rely heavily on reviews. Confirm your transfer to the airport for Day 13 and set an early alarm if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Maldives — wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Take a final dip in the Indian Ocean. After breakfast, complete packing and check out of your guesthouse. Arrange your transfer (speedboat or public ferry) back to Velana International Airport in Malé.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport. Complete check-in and security procedures. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts — Maldivian vanilla, local crafts, or chocolate. Reflect on your incredible 13-day budget honeymoon adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from the Maldives with hearts full of memories — snorkeling over vibrant reefs, romantic sunsets, starlit beaches, and the magical turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean. Until next time, Maldives!

meals.breakfast: Final guesthouse breakfast — make it special, fresh tropical fruit platter and local tea
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or cafe — budget $10-15 USD for airport pricing
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at connecting airport

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the ferry transfer to Malé and airport check-in procedures. Keep all important documents (passport, boarding passes, travel insurance) easily accessible. Total estimated budget for 13 days (excluding flights and accommodation): $400-700 USD per couple, covering meals, activities, transfers, and souvenirs.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet your resort transfer representative. Board a speedboat transfer to your boutique stay in North Malé Atoll (approx. 20–45 min). Check in, freshen up, and take a leisurely orientation walk around the resort property. Enjoy welcome drinks and get acquainted with the island's facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the resort beach or overwater jetty. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed welcome dinner, soaking in the ambient ocean views and the sound of gentle waves.

meals.breakfast: Enjoyed on the plane or at the airport
meals.lunch: Light snack or sandwich at Velana International Airport before or after landing
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the fresh grilled catch of the day with a tropical mocktail or house wine

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 low-key to recover from travel. Confirm all upcoming experience bookings with the resort concierge this evening. Ask about house reef snorkeling conditions and tide schedules for the week ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early and enjoy a full buffet breakfast at the resort. After breakfast, gear up for your first house reef snorkel session directly from the beach — explore the vibrant coral formations, spot reef fish, and get comfortable in the warm Indian Ocean waters. The house reef is ideal for a gentle introduction.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the resort's guided Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari. Hop aboard a dhoni boat and explore some of the North Malé Atoll's most spectacular coral gardens. Look out for sea turtles gliding through the water, white-tip reef sharks resting on the sandy bottom, and schools of colorful reef fish. The safari typically covers 2–3 prime snorkeling sites.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and shower before heading out for the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne. Board a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni, just the two of you, and sail across the turquoise lagoon as the sun dips below the horizon. Sip chilled champagne and enjoy canapés while watching the sky turn shades of orange and pink.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort — fresh tropical fruits, eggs station, pastries, and local Maldivian short eats
meals.lunch: Beachside grill or poolside café at the resort — try a tuna wrap or grilled fish burger with fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner back at the resort after the cruise — reserve a candlelit table on the beach for two

day_by_day.notes: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through the concierge. The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari typically departs mid-morning — confirm timing at check-in. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and an underwater camera.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast, then spend the morning at your own pace — lounge on the private beach, read, or take a gentle swim in the lagoon. This is a deliberate rest morning to recharge and embrace the island pace of life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment — a truly unique couples' experience inside a glass-walled underwater spa surrounded by the ocean and marine life. Choose from a couples' massage, body scrub, or aromatherapy treatment while rays and fish drift past the windows. This is one of the most memorable and romantic experiences the Maldives offers.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the jetty at dusk and watch the bioluminescent plankton light up the shallows (seasonal, check with resort). Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort's seafood-focused restaurant, toasting to the trip with a glass of local fruit wine or cocktail.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast at the resort — avocado toast, fresh juices, and Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut) for an authentic touch
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the spa café or poolside — fresh fruit platter, salad, and iced herbal tea post-treatment
meals.dinner: Seafood dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant — grilled lobster or snapper with saffron rice and a shared dessert

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment must be booked well in advance as slots are limited. Arrive 15 minutes early to shower and prepare. Avoid heavy meals directly before the treatment. Evening bioluminescence is best viewed from the beach or jetty between 8–10 PM on dark, calm nights.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast followed by a guided Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit. A resort boat takes you to a nearby inhabited local island where you'll meet a local family, tour the village, and learn about Maldivian culture, traditions, and daily life. Visit the local market and a small mosque.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cooking class experience — learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (tuna curry), and coconut-based sweets using fresh local ingredients. Sit down together and enjoy the meal you've prepared with your hosts.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a relaxed evening — take a sunset walk on the beach, try a resort cocktail at the bar, and enjoy a casual dinner back at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian meal prepared during the cooking class on the local island — included in the experience
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the Maldivian-inspired set menu to complement the day's cultural immersion

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for the local island visit — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim community. Bring cash for any small purchases at the local market (souvenirs, fresh coconuts). The cooking class is a wonderful opportunity to connect with authentic Maldivian culture beyond the resort bubble.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at the house reef — by now you'll be more familiar with the layout and can venture a bit further. Look for octopus, moray eels, and parrotfish in the deeper coral sections. Bring an underwater camera to document the marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a self-guided kayaking or paddleboarding session around the lagoon (equipment available from the resort's water sports center). Explore the calm, shallow waters at your own pace and enjoy the stunning turquoise scenery from the water level.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner experience. A speedboat whisks you to a remote, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the Indian Ocean as the sun sets. A table for two is set up in the sand with lanterns, rose petals, and a private chef who serves a curated multi-course dinner under a canopy of stars — one of the most romantic experiences of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort
meals.lunch: Beachside light lunch at the resort — fresh ceviche, tropical salad, and a mocktail
meals.dinner: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner — multi-course menu including fresh seafood, salads, dessert, and wine/champagne (included in the experience package)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Dinner is highly weather-dependent — have a backup date confirmed with the concierge. Bring a light wrap or shawl as it can be breezy on the sandbank after sunset. This is the most romantic evening of the trip — consider bringing a small personal gift or surprise for your partner.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, indulgent morning. Order in-room breakfast or enjoy it on your private terrace or deck. Take a long swim in the lagoon or simply relax with a book on the beach — embrace the true meaning of island time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a resort-organized dolphin watching excursion by dhoni boat. North Malé Atoll is home to large pods of spinner dolphins that are frequently spotted in the late afternoon. Watch them leap and spin in the wake of the boat against a backdrop of golden light.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a sundowner cocktail at the overwater bar. Enjoy dinner at the resort's themed night (check with resort — many boutique properties host Maldivian BBQ nights or seafood buffets on weekends).

meals.breakfast: In-room or terrace breakfast — continental spread with fresh fruits, yogurt, and pastries
meals.lunch: Poolside snacks and light bites — bruschetta, fresh fruit skewers, and iced coffee
meals.dinner: Weekend BBQ or seafood buffet night at the resort — grilled prawns, lobster, fresh fish, and tropical desserts

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are common but not guaranteed — the best time is between 4–6 PM when pods return to feeding grounds. Bring binoculars if available. Check with the concierge about the weekly BBQ night schedule as it may vary by season.

day_by_day.morning: Start the week with a sunrise yoga session on the beach or overwater deck (check if the resort offers guided sessions). Follow with a nourishing breakfast and a morning of complete relaxation by the pool or beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take part in a guided snorkeling excursion to a different reef site in the atoll — this time focusing on manta ray and shark spotting zones. The North Malé Atoll has several renowned cleaning stations where mantas congregate. Your resort dive center can organize this trip.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic evening stroll along the beach as the stars emerge. Head to the resort's fine dining restaurant for a special sit-down dinner — consider the tasting menu with wine pairing for a mid-trip celebration dinner.

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast post-yoga — smoothie bowls, granola, fresh tropical fruits, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the dhoni boat or back at the resort — sandwiches, fruit, and cold drinks
meals.dinner: Fine dining tasting menu at the resort's signature restaurant — 4–5 courses with wine pairing, celebrating the midpoint of your honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are seasonal — March is generally a good month in the Maldives for manta encounters. Confirm with the resort's marine biologist or dive center. Book the fine dining tasting menu in advance as it may require prior reservation.

day_by_day.morning: Morning at leisure — enjoy the resort's facilities at your own pace. Consider a visit to the resort spa for individual treatments (facial, foot massage, or body wrap) to rejuvenate mid-trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a stand-up paddleboard lesson or guided lagoon tour offered by the water sports center. The calm, shallow lagoon of North Malé Atoll is perfect for beginners and experienced paddlers alike. Explore the outer edges of the reef from above.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner cocktails on the beach followed by a casual dinner at the resort's beachside grill — a more relaxed and affordable option that's perfect for a laid-back Monday evening.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — try the local Maldivian breakfast section with roshi (flatbread) and tuna curry
meals.lunch: Fresh salad and grilled fish at the poolside café
meals.dinner: Beachside grill dinner — grilled catch of the day, grilled vegetables, and a shared dessert of coconut ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Day 8 is intentionally lighter on scheduled activities to allow for rest and spontaneity. Use this day to revisit any favorite spots from earlier in the trip or simply do nothing at all — the hallmark of a great Maldives holiday.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling before breakfast — the reef is often most active and calm in the early hours before wind picks up. Look for sea turtles feeding on the coral heads near the drop-off. Bring an underwater torch for deeper crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari to a different set of reef sites — the North Malé Atoll has numerous pristine coral gardens worth visiting multiple times. This safari may include a visit to a wreck or a deeper reef wall for more experienced snorkelers.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (or substitute with a resort-organized stargazing session on the beach or a rooftop deck if available). End the evening with dinner at the resort's themed restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Post-snorkel hearty breakfast — full buffet with eggs, local short eats, fresh juice, and coffee
meals.lunch: On-boat packed lunch during the snorkeling safari — sandwiches, fruit, and cold water provided by the resort
meals.dinner: Themed restaurant dinner at the resort — Asian fusion or Mediterranean menu depending on resort offerings

day_by_day.notes: By Day 9, you'll be comfortable in the water and can venture to more advanced snorkeling sites. Ask the resort's marine guide about the best sites for turtles specifically — they often know exact feeding grounds. Consider purchasing underwater photos from the resort photographer if available.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Spend the morning exploring the resort's boutique shop for souvenirs, local crafts, and Maldivian gifts to bring home. Pick up lacquerwork, woven mats, or locally produced coconut products.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a private snorkeling session with a resort marine biologist who can guide you through the reef ecosystem, explaining the coral species, fish behavior, and conservation efforts. This personalized experience adds depth and education to your snorkeling adventures.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a couples' cocktail-making class at the resort bar (if offered) or simply enjoy a long, leisurely sunset happy hour before dinner. Dine at the resort's main restaurant with a pre-selected romantic table setup — ask the concierge to arrange flowers and candles.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely à la carte breakfast — eggs benedict, fresh juices, and local honey
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — mezze platter, hummus, and fresh pita with a tropical smoothie
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's main restaurant — pre-arranged with the concierge for a special setup

day_by_day.notes: Use the morning shopping time to finalize souvenir purchases before the last few days. The private marine biologist snorkel tour is an enriching experience that many resorts offer — check availability and pricing with the concierge. It's a great way to deepen your understanding of the reef ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Final full-day snorkeling morning — revisit your favorite reef spot one last time. Take time to float quietly and absorb the beauty of the underwater world. Bring an underwater notebook to sketch or note your favorite marine life sightings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at the resort's infinity pool or beach. Enjoy a couple's spa session — choose from a traditional Maldivian hot stone massage or a coconut oil body wrap. This is a perfect way to pamper yourselves on one of the last full days.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the near-end of your honeymoon with a special dinner — revisit the sandbank picnic experience if weather allows, or book the resort's chef's table experience where a private chef prepares a personalized multi-course meal at a dedicated table.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast — stock up on energy for the morning snorkel
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — grilled fish tacos, fresh guacamole, and a frozen margarita
meals.dinner: Chef's table or premium dining experience — personalized menu with wine pairing, celebrating the end of a magical honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: This is your second-to-last full day — make it count. Consider writing a message in a bottle or a letter to each other to be opened on your first anniversary (a romantic gesture many resort concierges can help arrange). Confirm checkout time and transfer arrangements for Day 13.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean one last time. Take photos, sit in silence, and soak in the magic of your final morning in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Checkout formalities and settling of any outstanding resort bills. Pack, organize luggage, and store bags with the resort's bell service. Spend the last few hours at the beach or pool, savoring every last moment of the turquoise lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort — choose your favorite restaurant from the trip for one last meal. Toast to an unforgettable honeymoon and the memories made over the past 12 days.

meals.breakfast: Final full buffet breakfast at the resort — take your time and enjoy every bite
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the poolside café — keep it simple as you prepare for departure
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at your favorite resort restaurant — order your favorite dishes from the trip one last time

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer time to Velana International Airport for Day 13. Store luggage with the resort after checkout if your transfer is in the afternoon or evening. Use the remaining hours to swim, photograph, and simply be present in this extraordinary destination.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a light breakfast at the resort or grab a coffee and pastry from the resort café. Complete any last-minute packing and prepare for departure. Take a final walk along the jetty and beach for one last look at the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time before your departure flight. Browse the airport duty-free shops for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs, local spices, or gifts. Check in for your outbound flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport. Carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days — underwater wonders, golden sunsets, romantic dinners, and the timeless beauty of the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the resort or airport café — croissant, coffee, and fresh juice
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge meal before departure
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. The speedboat transfer from North Malé Atoll to the airport takes 20–45 minutes depending on exact resort location — factor this into your departure planning. Carry all valuables, underwater cameras, and fragile souvenirs in your hand luggage. Safe travels and congratulations on your honeymoon!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, Maldives Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking scenery.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three to four prime snorkeling spots across the atoll, with equipment provided and a marine biologist on hand to narrate the underwater world. Ideal for couples who love ocean adventures.
experiences.location: Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Maldives

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage or body treatment inside a stunning glass-walled underwater spa, surrounded by the gentle movement of tropical fish and coral reefs. This ultra-luxurious experience combines wellness with the mesmerizing beauty of the ocean, making it one of the most unique and romantic spa experiences in the world.

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean, where a candlelit table for two awaits. Enjoy a gourmet multi-course dinner featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, lobster, and tropical desserts, all prepared by a private chef. Stargazing under the Milky Way caps off this unforgettable honeymoon experience.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Step beyond the resort and visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Join a hands-on cooking class led by a local family, learning to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa short eats. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local mosque, and connect with the warm Maldivian community.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Met by a private resort representative, complete seamless VIP arrival formalities, and transfer via private luxury speedboat to your boutique resort in North Malé Atoll. Check in to your overwater villa with personalized welcome — chilled champagne, tropical fruit platter, and a scented flower bath drawn by your personal butler.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your villa, explore the resort grounds at leisure, and enjoy a romantic open-air welcome dinner at the resort's signature overwater restaurant. Watch the sun melt into the Indian Ocean as you dine under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and welcome bites served upon arrival at the resort, arranged by your butler
meals.dinner: Signature overwater restaurant at the resort — curated 4-course tasting menu featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood, paired with a premium wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Request early villa access if possible so luggage is unpacked and the room is fully prepared before your speedboat arrives. Confirm butler preferences and any dietary requirements upon check-in. Tip: keep the first evening relaxed to recover from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent in-villa breakfast served on your private deck overlooking the lagoon. Afterward, take a guided house reef snorkeling session with a resort marine biologist — discover vibrant coral formations, parrotfish, and reef sharks right off your villa's steps.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari: Board a private dhoni and head to the most spectacular coral gardens in North Malé Atoll. Swim alongside sea turtles, white-tip reef sharks, and schools of tropical fish in crystal-clear waters. Your guide will narrate the marine ecosystem and ensure the most photogenic underwater encounters.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the villa for a sunset cocktail hour on your private deck. Dine at the resort's beachside grill restaurant for a relaxed yet refined evening.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private breakfast — freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit, eggs to order, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian roshi flatbread with coconut sambal
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet snorkeling picnic box provided on the dhoni — artisan sandwiches, fresh fruit, chilled juices, and local sweet treats
meals.dinner: Beachside grill restaurant — whole grilled catch of the day, lobster thermidor, and a curated cocktail menu featuring local ingredients like pandan and coconut

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary reef-safe products. Bring an underwater camera or rent one from the dive center for the snorkeling safari. Best snorkeling visibility is typically in the morning hours.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga session on the overwater yoga pavilion, led by the resort's private instructor. Follow with a nourishing wellness breakfast at the spa café. Then enjoy a relaxed swim in your private villa pool before heading out.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne: Set sail on a traditionally crafted Maldivian dhoni, privately chartered exclusively for you. Cruise the turquoise lagoon, sip chilled Moët & Chandon, enjoy canapés, and watch the sky transform into shades of gold and coral as the sun dips below the horizon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort glowing from the sunset experience. Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner for two at the resort's private dining pavilion on the beach, with a personalized menu curated by the executive chef.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the spa café — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, cold-pressed juices, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: In-villa dining — light Mediterranean mezze platter with hummus, grilled vegetables, fresh pita, and chilled rosé
meals.dinner: Private beach dining pavilion — 5-course chef's tasting menu with optional wine pairing; menu includes seared tuna tataki, lobster bisque, and a decadent chocolate fondant dessert

day_by_day.notes: Book the private sunset dhoni cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. Request a specific champagne brand or sparkling wine if you have a preference. The dhoni cruise typically lasts 1.5 to 2 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning kayak or stand-up paddleboard session across the glassy lagoon, available from the resort's water sports center. Paddle around the sandbanks and enjoy the stillness of the early morning ocean before the day heats up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment: Descend into the resort's spectacular glass-walled underwater spa for a couples' deep-tissue massage or a signature Maldivian body ritual. Watch reef fish and coral pass by through the panoramic windows as expert therapists work away any remaining travel fatigue. The treatment typically lasts 90 minutes.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's rooftop bar for sunset cocktails with panoramic 360-degree views of the atoll. Then enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort's Japanese-inspired teppanyaki restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant buffet — extensive spread of international and Maldivian options including mas huni (tuna and coconut), fresh tropical fruits, and made-to-order egg station
meals.lunch: Light poolside dining — seared ahi tuna salad, coconut prawn skewers, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Teppanyaki restaurant — live chef performance, wagyu beef, fresh Maldivian lobster, and Japanese whisky selection

day_by_day.notes: Book the underwater spa well in advance as it is the most sought-after experience at the resort and slots fill quickly. Arrive 20 minutes early to enjoy the relaxation lounge and complimentary herbal teas. Avoid eating a heavy meal immediately before the treatment.

day_by_day.morning: Join the resort's marine biologist for a private coral restoration experience — plant coral fragments onto underwater frames in the lagoon as part of the resort's sustainability program. A deeply meaningful and memorable activity that connects you to the ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit: Board a speedboat to a nearby inhabited local island. Explore the village, visit the local market, and learn about traditional Maldivian life. Then participate in an immersive cooking class led by a local chef — prepare garudhiya (tuna broth), rihaakuru paste, and coconut-based curries using fresh local ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort with a bag of handmade local souvenirs. Enjoy a private in-villa dinner — your butler sets up a candlelit table on your overwater deck with the dishes inspired by the day's cooking class.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — Maldivian-style with freshly baked roshi, tuna curry, coconut sambal, and black tea
meals.lunch: Authentic local lunch on the inhabited island — fresh fish curry, rice, and local short eats (hedhikaa) prepared by the cooking class host
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — a curated Maldivian feast prepared by the resort chef, served on your overwater deck under the stars with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting the local island — shoulders and knees should be covered out of respect for local customs. The cooking class typically lasts 2 to 3 hours including the island exploration. Bring cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD for any small purchases at the local market.

day_by_day.morning: A full leisure morning — sleep in, order a lavish in-villa breakfast, and spend time floating in your private villa pool or swinging gently in your overwater hammock. Read, reconnect, and simply be present in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner preparation day: In the afternoon, enjoy a private snorkeling session at a nearby drift dive site known for its strong currents and abundant marine life — hammerhead sharks, eagle rays, and manta rays are occasionally spotted here. Guided by a certified resort divemaster.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy sundowners at the resort's overwater bar, followed by a themed 'Maldivian Night' dinner event at the resort's beach restaurant featuring traditional Bodu Beru drumming performances, fire dancing, and a buffet of authentic Maldivian cuisine.

meals.breakfast: In-villa champagne breakfast — eggs benedict, smoked salmon, freshly squeezed juices, pastry basket, and a bottle of chilled Veuve Clicquot
meals.lunch: Pool bar light bites — fresh ceviche, grilled corn, tropical fruit skewers, and a signature resort mocktail
meals.dinner: Maldivian Night beach buffet — authentic local dishes including mas riha (fish curry), fihunu mas (grilled fish), and coconut-based desserts, accompanied by cultural performances

day_by_day.notes: The drift snorkeling session requires moderate swimming ability. Confirm conditions with the dive center the morning before. The Maldivian Night event may be a weekly occurrence — confirm the schedule with your butler upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Mark the midpoint of your trip with a sunrise dolphin watching excursion — depart by speedboat at dawn to seek out the resident spinner dolphin pods that frequent the channels around North Malé Atoll. A truly magical and intimate wildlife experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return for a leisurely brunch, then spend the afternoon indulging in back-to-back spa treatments at the resort's wellness center — choose from a Maldivian coconut oil massage, a volcanic stone therapy, or a brightening tropical facial. Finish with a float in the hydrotherapy pool.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the Indian Ocean. A candlelit table is set for two on the white sand, surrounded by lanterns and flowers. A private chef prepares a bespoke 4-course dinner as the stars emerge above you.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-excursion snack box — energy bars, banana, and a thermos of hot coffee, provided on the dolphin watching boat
meals.lunch: Late champagne brunch at the resort's main restaurant — eggs royale, charcuterie, sushi station, and a Bellini bar
meals.dinner: Private sandbank dinner — customized 4-course menu featuring chilled seafood tower, lobster thermidor, filet mignon, and a bespoke dessert with your names written in chocolate, paired with a premium wine selection

day_by_day.notes: The private sandbank dinner is the most exclusive experience of the trip — confirm all menu preferences, dietary restrictions, and any romantic extras (rose petals, personalized messages, a musician) with your butler at least 48 hours in advance. Weather contingency plans should be discussed.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a completely free morning with no schedule. Sleep late, order breakfast in bed, and spend the morning in your villa. Optional: take a short guided meditation session offered by the resort's wellness team on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Big game fishing excursion: Board a private fishing charter and head into the deeper blue waters beyond the atoll. Try your hand at catch-and-release sport fishing for wahoo, yellowfin tuna, and dorado. The resort can prepare your catch for dinner if desired.
day_by_day.evening: Return from fishing and freshen up. Enjoy a refined dinner at the resort's fine dining restaurant, potentially featuring your own catch of the day prepared by the executive chef in your preferred style.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast in bed — continental spread with croissants, jams, tropical fruit, yogurt parfait, and freshly brewed specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet lunch box on the fishing charter — gourmet wraps, fresh fruit, energy snacks, and cold beverages
meals.dinner: Resort fine dining restaurant — chef's preparation of your day's catch, complemented by a premium wine pairing menu and a chocolate and caramel dessert tasting plate

day_by_day.notes: Fishing charters typically depart mid-morning and return in the late afternoon. Bring seasickness medication if you are prone to motion sickness on open water. Confirm catch-and-release versus keep-and-cook preferences with the charter team in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (second session, different site): Return to the water for another extraordinary snorkeling safari, this time exploring a different coral garden system known for its dense sea turtle population and colorful soft coral walls. An unmissable repeat experience in a new location.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a poolside afternoon. Enjoy a private mixology class with the resort's head bartender — learn to craft classic Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like pandan syrup, fresh coconut water, and tropical fruits. Take home your own recipe cards.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the overwater bar, then a romantic dinner at the resort's Italian-inspired restaurant featuring handmade pasta, fresh seafood, and an extensive Italian wine cellar.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant — à la carte breakfast with eggs florentine, acai bowls, fresh juices, and artisan coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside dining — grilled tiger prawns with garlic butter, Caesar salad, and a chilled glass of Sancerre
meals.dinner: Italian-inspired resort restaurant — handmade tagliolini with Maldivian lobster, burrata with heirloom tomatoes, and a tiramisu prepared tableside

day_by_day.notes: The mixology class is a fun and interactive afternoon activity — great for couples. Ask the bartender to teach you the resort's signature cocktail as a memento. The Italian restaurant may require reservations — book through your butler the morning of.

day_by_day.morning: Morning seaplane excursion over the atolls: Board a private seaplane for a scenic 30-minute flight over the breathtaking aerial mosaic of the Maldivian atolls — a perspective that defines the Maldives and makes for extraordinary photographs. Land on a remote atoll for a brief beach stop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment (second session): Return to the glass-walled underwater spa for a different treatment — opt for a couples' Ayurvedic oil ritual or a revitalizing deep-sea mineral body wrap, followed by a private jacuzzi session overlooking the reef.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your 10th day in paradise with a special in-villa dinner set up by your butler — a beautifully decorated overwater deck with floating candles, flower arrangements, and a personalized menu. Toast to the trip with a bottle of vintage Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the seaplane — fresh fruit, yogurt, and espresso at the resort café
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic on the remote atoll beach during the seaplane stop — chilled seafood, artisan bread, tropical fruits, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — 5-course romantic dinner with personalized menu, vintage Champagne, and a dessert featuring a custom message from the chef

day_by_day.notes: Seaplane flights are weather-dependent and typically operate during daylight hours only. Book well in advance and confirm the morning of departure. Weight restrictions apply for seaplanes — typically 15 kg per person including hand luggage.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning on the beach. Collect shells, walk the shoreline, and enjoy the simplicity of the Maldivian morning light. Optional: join a guided birdwatching walk around the island to spot resident and migratory seabirds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (second experience, different route): Embark on a second dhoni cruise, this time exploring a different stretch of the atoll — pass by uninhabited islands, spot sea turtles surfacing, and enjoy another spectacular champagne sunset on the water.
day_by_day.evening: Return for a final indulgent spa treatment — a full-body exfoliation and wrap using Maldivian coconut and sea salt, followed by a relaxing foot ritual. Then enjoy dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant one last time.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — smoothie bowls, granola, fresh coconut, and a pot of single-origin Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Beach club lunch — lobster rolls, grilled corn on the cob, watermelon salad, and fresh lemonade
meals.dinner: Overwater signature restaurant — 4-course seafood-focused tasting menu with ocean views, paired with a sommelier-selected wine flight

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to begin any souvenir shopping at the resort boutique or plan to purchase local crafts. Begin packing non-essential items to ease the departure process on the final day.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session on the house reef — a personal, unguided farewell swim to say goodbye to the turtles, reef fish, and coral you have come to know over the past two weeks. Take your time and savor every moment underwater.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cooking Class revisit or cultural afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's cultural center learning traditional Maldivian crafts — lacquer work (laajehun), mat weaving, or traditional music. A meaningful way to deepen your connection to the destination before leaving.
day_by_day.evening: Final farewell dinner at the resort — request the chef's special 'Farewell Menu,' a curated last supper celebrating the flavors of the Maldives. Your butler arranges a personalized table setup with a parting gift from the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant — full à la carte breakfast, take your time and order generously
meals.lunch: In-villa private lunch — a light and refreshing spread of mezze, fresh sashimi, and tropical fruit to keep energy high for the afternoon
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — chef's personalized farewell tasting menu, complimentary dessert with a handwritten farewell card from the team, and a parting glass of vintage Champagne

day_by_day.notes: Settle your villa account this evening to avoid a rushed checkout tomorrow. Confirm your departure speedboat time with the front desk. Leave a review or personal note for your butler and the team — it means a great deal to the staff.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in paradise — wake up early for one last sunrise from your overwater deck. Enjoy a slow, nostalgic breakfast in the villa. Take a final dip in your private pool and walk the beach barefoot one last time. Complete checkout formalities assisted by your butler.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private speedboat transfer to Velana International Airport, accompanied by resort staff for a seamless VIP departure. Arrive at the airport with time to enjoy the premium lounge before your flight. Carry the memories of 13 extraordinary days in the Maldives as you depart.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — in-flight

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa breakfast — a full and indulgent spread: eggs benedict, smoked salmon, pastries, tropical fruit, fresh juices, and specialty coffee enjoyed on your overwater deck
meals.lunch: Premium airport lounge — light bites, refreshments, and cocktails while awaiting departure
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5 to 3 hours before your flight for the speedboat transfer and airport check-in. The resort will arrange luggage handling and transfer coordination. Take one last photograph from your villa deck — the memory of that view will stay with you forever.
